كَابِسٌ Charging, attacking, or assaulting. (K, * TA.) You say, جَآءَ كَابِسًا He came charging, attacking, or assaulting: (K, * TA:) as also ↓ مُكَبِّسًا , and ↓ مُكَابِسًا . (TA.) ―
-b2- Throwing himself suddenly and without consideration [upon a person or thing]. (TA.) ＝
-A2- A man putting himself within his garment, covering his body with it. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
